articles.headline: India scraps import duties on key mobile-phone and electronics parts
articles.summary: India removed 7.5% and 5% import duties on some components used to make mobile phones and other electronics. That lowers input costs for device makers and suppliers, and could improve margins or pricing flexibility for companies such as Apple and Xiaomi.

articles.headline: AMD reports earnings as investors question AI infrastructure spending
articles.summary: AMD's second-quarter earnings became a key market read on whether skepticism about AI infrastructure spending is spreading across chips and cloud. For businesses, the bigger issue is whether this signals higher scrutiny on AI capex, supplier demand, and future hardware availability.

articles.headline: OpenAI cuts GPT-5.6 Luna prices by 80% as AI cost pressure intensifies
articles.summary: OpenAI sharply reduced pricing for one of its GPT-5.6 models, signaling that enterprise AI buyers are becoming highly sensitive to token costs. For businesses, this could lower inference spend and accelerate adoption of AI tools, while also increasing pricing pressure across the model market.
